data.decision: Migrate Mission #0 with cp -a, diff -r, and git rm after directory rename failed on Windows
data.why: git mv and the Windows move command both returned access denied for a directory rename. cp -a produced an identical tree (diff -r exited 0), and git rm removed the source only after that check.
data.cost_if_wrong: A missed or altered file would show in diff -r; the validator and reconcile both pass on the migrated mission, and the ledger/evidence bytes are unchanged.
